description: Alkali-resistant glass fibre mesh (in compliance with the ETAG 004 guide) for reinforcing protective waterproofing layers, anti-fracture membranes and thermal insulation systems
whereToUse: Mapelastic, Mapelastic Smart, Mapelastic Turbo or Monolastic used for waterproofing terraces, balconies, swimming pools, baths, shower cubicles, etc. with ceramic tile or stone finishes
protective, flexible smoothing layers of Mapelastic, Mapelastic Smart, Mapelastic Turbo or Monolastic applied on internal and external cementitious substrates with micro cracks
products of the Plastimul range when applied on substrates with micro cracks

standards.value: in compliance with the ETAG 004 guide
The mesh is made of glass fibres treated with a special coating that provides resistance to alkalis (as specified in ETAG 004, paragraph 5.6.7.1).

technicalData.label: Breaking strength of mesh (ETAG 004 CI.5.6.7.1.1)
technicalData.value: warp > 32 N/mm (1600 N/5 cm) weft > 32 N/mm (1600 N/5 cm)

technicalData.label: Breaking strength after ageing alkaline solution (ETAG 004 CI 5.6.7.1.2)
technicalData.value: warp ≥ 20 N/mm (1000 N/5 cm) weft ≥ 20 N/mm (1000 N/5 cm), always > 50% of the value as is

consumption.basis: Overlap allowance between pieces of mesh (not a consumption rate; adds to the mesh area needed)
consumption.quote: Overlap each piece of Mapenet 150 by at least 5 cm.

storage: The product may be stored for limitless time if stored in a clean and dry place.
notes: The sheet has no CONSUMPTION section; the only quantity figure is the 5 cm overlap between pieces. No m2-per-roll figure is printed (only '50 metre rolls, 1 m wide'). There is no separate STORAGE heading: the storage sentence is printed inside the PACKAGING section and has been split out into storage. whereToUse items a) to d) are printed under the lead-in 'Reinforced strengthening for:'; the list letters and trailing semicolons are trimmed. Roll width and length appear only under PACKAGING; the technical data table has no width, length or thickness row (mesh size and weight only). The description mentions thermal insulation systems and anti-fracture membranes but the WHERE TO USE list does not. No limits/'do not use' statements are printed.
